args.body: Take CATALOGUE-AGENCY-OFFER-TEST. I read the current 7,224-byte live-source page: its CTA is general feedback and explicitly accepts no paid orders. Reuse the existing CAD60 agency proposal and executed QA evidence to make a narrow, nonbinding offer test on that page. This is a conversion hypothesis, not evidence of agency demand or a solution to missing exposure. Stop at exact-digest independent-review handoff; no outreach, deployment, new inventory or discovery submissions. Four unclassified feedback sources remain unknown. Keep operator order acceptance/payment separate and preserve every existing deadline.

description: The live catalogue page offers only a free script and general feedback; it does not test the existing agency QA offer. Four unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Prepare one bounded agency offer on that existing page, retaining independent review. Funds and revenue remain unverified; operator acceptance and payment are separate dependencies.
